title_en: Call for Participants: UNAIDS Fellowship Program, First Half of 2027
summary: Eligible undergraduate and graduate students of the University who wish to serve as fellows at UNAIDS may apply to this program run by the Office of International Affairs. Applicants must submit their application through a Google Form by 11:00 on Friday, 20 November 2026. Full details are in the attached recruitment notice, which was not read for this translation.
applies_to: This is a voluntary application, open only to the following students. Undergraduate students: currently enrolled students of the University (students on leave of absence are not eligible) who have completed at least two semesters at the University. Graduate students: currently enrolled students of the University (students on leave of absence are not eligible) who have completed at least one semester at the University, and graduate research students. Applicants must also have a cumulative GPA in their current degree program of at least 2.7 (undergraduate) or 3.3 (graduate), and must be fluent in English.
conditions: Students on leave of absence are not eligible.
Undergraduate applicants must have completed at least two semesters at the University.
Graduate applicants must have completed at least one semester at the University; graduate research students are also eligible.
Applicants must have a cumulative GPA in their current degree program of at least 2.7 (undergraduate) or 3.3 (graduate).
Applicants must be fluent in English; English proficiency will be assessed at an interview.
International students holding a D-2 (study) visa must check in advance their individual visa and residence status in relation to leave of absence and return from leave.
The fellowship is an unpaid dispatched (placement) position; support funding from the Office of International Affairs is described only in the attachment, which was not read.
The detailed schedule is given only in the attachment, which was not read.
steps: Read the attached recruitment notice (PDF) and the Terms of Reference (ToR) list for each office; these attachments were not read for this translation.
Download the submission forms (attachment 3, 제출양식.zip) and complete them as instructed in the attached recruitment notice.
If you are an international student holding a D-2 (study) visa, check your individual visa and residence status in relation to leave of absence and return from leave before applying.

Submit your application through the Google Form by 11:00 on Friday, 20 November 2026; the form link is not included in the text of the notice. For questions, contact the office named in the original notice.
translation:
Title: Call for Participants: UNAIDS Fellowship Program, First Half of 2027

Under an agreement with an international organization, the Office of International Affairs is recruiting participants to work as fellows at UNAIDS, as follows.

A. Fellowship overview
- Period: March 2027 to August 2027 (6 months)
- Working conditions: dispatched placement (unpaid)

B. Main schedule (see the attachment for the detailed schedule; the attachment was not read for this translation)

C. Eligibility
1) Enrolment status
 a) Undergraduate students: currently enrolled students of the University (students on leave of absence are not included) who have completed at least two semesters at the University
 b) Graduate students: currently enrolled students of the University (students on leave of absence are not included) who have completed at least one semester at the University, and graduate research students
 ※ International students holding a D-2 (study) visa must check in advance their individual visa and residence status in relation to leave of absence and return from leave.
2) Grades: cumulative GPA in the current degree program of at least 2.7 for undergraduates and at least 3.3 for graduate students
3) Fluency in English: English proficiency will be assessed at the interview.

D. Support from the Office of International Affairs: support funding (see attachment; not read for this translation)

E. How to apply: submit the Google Form by 11:00 on Friday, 20 November 2026. ※ Please check the attached recruitment notice for detailed information.

Enclosures
1. 2026 UNAIDS Fellowship Program recruitment notice, 1 copy
2. Terms of Reference (ToR) list by office, 1 copy
3. Submission forms, 1 copy

Attached files (3) (not read for this translation)
1. 2027년 상반기 UNAIDS 인턴십 참가자 모집 공고문.pdf (Recruitment notice for participants in the UNAIDS Internship, first half of 2027) (87 KB)
2. Terms of Reference - SNU-UNAIDS Fellowship Program.zip (1 MB)
3. 제출양식.zip (Submission forms) (39 KB)
